Rounded corners required; sharp corners acceptable only in relief groove with rounded chamfer edge

summary: This standard defines the geometric requirements for seal ring housing working zones in gearbox housings. It specifies chamfer angles (2°), relief radii (0.4–1.2 mm based on diameter), minimum effective spacing (1 mm), and assembly sequence rules when bearings and seals share the same fitting diameter. The page includes detailed guidance on surface finish methods (plunge grinding, helical milling) and mandates rounded edges with specified tolerances and roughness in critical zone 'L'.
